title: Detailed avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Avocado outer skin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='38' fill='#2d6a1e'/>
  <!-- Lighter rim of skin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='36' fill='#3e8a2a'/>
  <!-- Inner flesh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='23' ry='33' fill='#c8e86b'/>
  <!-- Flesh highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='14' ry='22' fill='#dbf28a'/>
  <!-- Pit -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='13' fill='#8b5e2e'/>
  <!-- Pit highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='51' r='5' fill='#a8753e'/>
  <!-- Pit shadow ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#6e4520' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Stem nub at top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='14' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a3a14'/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='13' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#7a5228'/>
  <!-- Texture speckles on flesh -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='35' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='70' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='1' fill='#b0d455'/>
  <!-- Skin texture lines -->
  <path d='M28 40 Q25 52 28 64' fill='none' stroke='#245a18' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M72 40 Q75 52 72 64' fill='none' stroke='#245a18' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Flesh-skin separation line -->
  <path d='M30 30 Q28 52 30 74' fill='none' stroke='#9bc44a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M70 30 Q72 52 70 74' fill='none' stroke='#9bc44a' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
